title: Intentional Homicides Fell 50 Percent Between September 2024 and October 2026, Sheinbaum Says
author: Arturo Sánchez and Emir Olivares
content:
_This article by[Arturo
Sánchez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Arturo%20S%C3%A1nchez%20Jim%C3%A9nez)
and [Emir
Olivares](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Emir%20Olivares,%20enviado)
originally appeared in the [November 10, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/10/politica/homicidos-
dolosos-se-redujeron-50-por-ciento-entre-septiembre-de-2024-y-octubre-
de-2026-sheinbaum), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The daily average of intentional homicides in the country
fell **50 percent** between September 2024 and October 2026, from **86.9 to
43.4** , making last month the October with the fewest murders since 2015. The
figure, however, has remained virtually unchanged since August, when 43.3
murders per day were recorded, the same as in September.

> I'll give you an advance: 50 percent reduction in intentional homicides.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo announced the figure this Tuesday as she
opened her customary press conference at the National Palace, where the
monthly security report was presented.

Marcela Figueroa Franco, head of the Executive Secretariat of the National
Public Security System (SESNSP), detailed that from January to October seven
states concentrated **52.5 percent** of homicides: State of Mexico (10.6
percent), Guanajuato (8.2), Baja California (8.1), Sinaloa (7.8), Chihuahua
(7.5), Guerrero (5.4) and Morelos (4.9). Compared to the same period in 2025,
all 32 states reduced their daily average; San Luis Potosí stands out with a
drop of **77 percent** , Nayarit with 71.8 percent fewer homicides, Quintana
Roo with a reduction of 57.7 percent, as well as Baja California Sur and Nuevo
León, with reductions of 54.1 and 50.1 percent, respectively.

High-impact crimes across the country fell 36 percent, from 636.6 per day in
October 2024 to 409.4 in this past October, and violent vehicle theft dropped
52 percent, from 149.1 to 72.2.

Perception of insecurity stood at 58.1 percent in the third quarter, **its
lowest since 2013** , according to the National Survey of Urban Public
Security (ENSU) by the National Institute of Statistics and Geography (INEGI).
Meanwhile, the population that feels unsafe in their neighborhood fell from
50.1 to 35.9 percent, its lowest level since 2018, according to the National
Victimization and Perception of Public Security Survey (ENVIPE).

The Secretary of Security and Citizen Protection, Omar García Harfuch,
reported that since July 6, 2025, when the National Anti-Extortion Strategy
began, 2,395 people have been arrested for that crime, among them Luis
Humberto "N," alias _Keegan_ , identified as the leader of _La Empresa_.

So far this administration, 74,033 people have been arrested for various
crimes, 37,625 weapons and 588.6 tons of drugs have been seized, and 2,841
clandestine laboratories have been dismantled.

Among recent cases, he cited the capture in Nuevo Laredo of Gerardo Javier N,
_La Pocha_ , of the Cartel del Noreste, wanted for extradition by the United
States, and the death in clashes of Edgar Arón N, _El General_ , alleged
mastermind of the murder of police officer Milton Morales, and of Jesús N,
_Chuy González_ , an operator of the Sinaloa Cartel for whom a reward of up to
5 million dollars had been offered.

The Secretary of Governance, Rosa Icela Rodríguez, presented advances in
addressing the causes of violence, including 155,700 young people in Jóvenes
Construyendo el Futuro and 14,157 weapons handed in under the exchange
program.
